subject: Horizon Pangenome Suite, Adaptive Pair-HMM, E-Graph Resolver, and HPRC Benchmarks

claims.summary: stream_gfa supports .gfa.gz and stdin with unit tests for empty L-line orientations, and src/coord.rs is wired into src/lib.rs.

source.quote: `stream_gfa` provides a buffered line-streaming GFA v1.0/v1.1 reader (supporting `.gfa`, multi-member BGZF `.gfa.gz` via `MultiGzDecoder`, and `"-"` `stdin`, with unit tests for empty `L`-line orientations and `.gfa.gz`).

claims.summary: Normalized Pair-HMM transitions (src/mdl/dp.rs, src/mdl/dag.rs) and adaptive identity_prior/gap_open_bits/gap_extend_bits (src/mdl/mod.rs) achieve 63.6% recall / 61.0% precision on cactus241way Dog chr22 1MB (15.11s).

source.quote: All results were generated out-of-the-box using the divergence-adaptive Pair-HMM (`HmmParams`: `identity_prior`, `gap_open_bits`, and `gap_extend_bits` estimated from LCB anchors with Beta prior shrinkage in `src/mdl/mod.rs`), BOCPD compositional profiles (`src/bocpd.rs`), and normalized Pair-HMM transitions (`src/mdl/dp.rs`, `src/mdl/dag.rs`).

claims.summary: All target pangenome binaries (horizon_clean, horizon_resolve, horizon_lift, horizon_wga --graph) are implemented in src/bin/ and pass 39+ unit tests.

source.quote: All target pangenome binaries (`horizon_wga`, `horizon_wga --graph`, `horizon_merge`, `horizon_guide`, `horizon_eval`, `horizon_gfa`, `horizon_clean`, `horizon_resolve`, `horizon_lift`, `bench_chr1`) are now implemented in `src/bin/` (`40` passing tests + `1` ignored; `4` of `9` binaries — `bench_chr1`, `horizon_eval`, `horizon_guide`, `horizon_merge` — have `0` unit tests).

claims.summary: horizon_lift --bridge-bp 10 lifts 500 GRCh38.chr22 1-kb windows to CHM13.chr22 on the 12 GB HPRC graph in 256.60s at 619.2 MB peak RSS.

source.quote: Two-pass graph liftover (`horizon_lift --bridge-bp 10` on 500 `GRCh38.chr22` 1-kb windows -> `CHM13.chr22`): **256.60s**, **619.2 MB** peak RSS (`469` exact, `1` partial, `19` split, `11` unmapped).

claims.summary: horizon_wga --resolve-dups and horizon_clean run on real 5 Mbp HPRC chr22 and chr6 pericentromeres (23.45s and 17.60s, 3.08 GB RSS; horizon_clean 0.01s, <=7.8 MB RSS) plus 5 Mbp MHC vs synthetic C4 dup (25.08s, 3.35 GB RSS).

source.quote: Real HPRC `chr22` Pericentromere 5 Mbp (`GRCh38.chr22:15.5M-20.5M` vs `CHM13.chr22:15.73M-20.73M`): **23.45s**, **3,084.5 MB** peak RSS, **5,894,191** aligned pairs, `246` fwd / `184` rev LCBs, `17,789` Horizon Bubbles (`horizon_clean`: `6,030` links kept, **0.01s**, **7.8 MB** RSS).

claims.summary: horizon_resolve collapses 840 tandem duplications across 20 GFA v1.1 walks (4,500 steps), saving 308,760.9 MDL bits in 4.48s at 24.0 MB peak RSS.

source.quote: | GFA E-Graph Resolver | `horizon_resolve --collapse-dups` | 200 segs, 20 walks x 225 steps (`4,500` steps) | `280` windows, `840` dups collapsed, `308,760.9` bits saved | **24.0 MB** | 4.48s |

claims.summary: horizon_wga --graph expands bidirected minus-orientation GFA links and uses MASK_W10+MASK_RY20 seeded subgraph isolation (align_seq_to_dag_seeded), aligning a 96-bp query in 0.0031s.

source.quote: `align_seq_to_dag_seeded` uses `MASK_W10` + `MASK_RY20` intra-node spaced seeds (requiring `>=14` bp segments) and ancestor-then-descendant reachability closure to isolate relevant DAG components before running `align_seq_to_dag_mdl` (bypassed when `nodes.len() <= 8` or `seed_hits.is_empty()`).

claims.summary: Replacing HashSet with sorted/deduplicated Vec reduces pair-collection overhead, while ContigIndex HashMap seed maps still consume ~0.29 GB/Mbp (26.5 GB RSS on full 170.8 Mbp chr6 before cancellation).

source.quote: (After replacing `HashSet<(usize, usize)>` with sorted/deduplicated `Vec<(usize, usize)>`, full 170.8 Mbp `GRCh38.chr6` vs 110.7 Mbp `CHM13.chr6` still reached **26.5 GB** RSS and `47:33` CPU before cancellation on the 30 GiB host due to `ContigIndex`'s per-position `HashMap<u64, Vec<usize>>` seed maps, ~0.29 GB/Mbp.)

quotes: Pairwise WGA results use the divergence-adaptive Pair-HMM (`HmmParams`: `identity_prior`, `gap_open_bits`, and `gap_extend_bits` estimated from LCB anchors with Beta prior shrinkage in `src/mdl/mod.rs`), BOCPD compositional profiles (`src/bocpd.rs`), and normalized Pair-HMM transitions (`src/mdl/dp.rs`, `src/mdl/dag.rs`). Note that `mdl_xdrop_extend` (`src/mdl/dp.rs`) still uses static defaults (`IDENTITY_PRIOR`, `GAP_OPEN_BITS`, `GAP_EXTEND_BITS`), `horizon_wga --graph` passes `&HmmParams::default()`, `KARLIN_MDL_COEFF = 0.55` remains a fixed constant, and MAF-extracted FASTAs sample homologous blocks. Earlier WGA rows (`multiz100way`, `cactus447way`, `multiz470way`, `cactus241way chr22_random`, `GRCh38.chr22 vs CHM13.chr22`) were recorded prior to `0e70693`/`b18f25b` and have not yet been re-run on `b18f25b` (`cactus241way chr22 1MB` was re-run on `b18f25b` and shifted from `64.3%` to `63.6%` recall).
* **Multi-species merging (`horizon_merge`):** Implemented in `src/bin/horizon_merge.rs` (best-score interval netting; no multi-species benchmark row or binary unit tests yet).

* Two-pass graph liftover (`horizon_lift --bridge-bp 10` on 500 `+`-strand `GRCh38.chr22:16.0M-49.9M` 1-kb windows -> `CHM13.chr22`, excluding `0-16.0M` p-arm/centromere): **256.60s**, **619.2 MB** peak RSS (`469` exact including `<=10 bp` bridged gaps, `1` partial, `19` split, `11` unmapped; no external coordinate truth oracle).

* Pairwise alignment (`horizon_wga --resolve-dups` on `GRCh38.chr22` vs `CHM13.chr22`, pre-`0e70693`): **154.92s**, **24,365,611** many-to-many `(x, y)` aligned pairs (non-deduplicated ratio `68.5%` vs `35.6 Mbp` `CHM13.chr22` q-arm), `60` fwd / `4` rev LCBs, `9,690` Horizon Bubbles.

* Real HPRC `chr22` Pericentromere 5 Mbp (`GRCh38.chr22:15.5M-20.5M` vs `CHM13.chr22:15.73M-20.73M`): **23.45s**, **3,084.5 MB** peak RSS, **5,894,191** many-to-many `(x, y)` aligned pairs, `246` fwd / `184` rev LCBs, `17,789` Horizon Bubbles (`horizon_clean` on `*`-sequence `sup>0` pairwise GFA: `6,030` links kept, `0` severed, **0.01s**, **7.8 MB** RSS).

* Real HPRC `chr6` Pericentromere 5 Mbp (`GRCh38.chr6:61.0M-66.0M` vs `CHM13.chr6:61.4M-66.4M`): **17.60s**, **3,084.5 MB** peak RSS, **4,785,880** many-to-many `(x, y)` aligned pairs, `264` fwd / `326` rev LCBs, `24,916` Horizon Bubbles (`horizon_clean` on `*`-sequence `sup>0` pairwise GFA: `2,776` links kept, `0` severed, **0.01s**, **5.0 MB** RSS).

* `chr6` q-arm 20 Mbp (`GRCh38.chr6:65M-85M` vs `CHM13.chr6:61.4M-81.4M`): **81.33s**, **5,863.3 MB** peak RSS (`0.293 GB/Mbp`), **15,021,911** many-to-many `(x, y)` aligned pairs (`75.1%` non-deduplicated ratio), `36` fwd / `41` rev LCBs, `21,475` Horizon Bubbles. (After replacing `HashSet<(usize, usize)>` with sorted/deduplicated `Vec<(usize, usize)>`, full `GRCh38.chr6` `170.8 Mbp` vs `CHM13.chr6` `110.7 Mbp` reached **26.5 GB** mid-run RSS — `0.094 GB/Mbp` combined, `0.155 GB/Mbp` ref-only — at `47:33` CPU before cancellation on the 30 GiB host due to `ContigIndex` `HashMap<u64, Vec<usize>>` seed maps.)

| GFA Junction Cleaner | `horizon_clean` | `*`-seq pairwise `chr22`/`chr6` peri GFAs (`6,030` / `2,776` `sup>0` links) | `6,030` / `2,776` kept, `0` severed (no-op) | **7.8 MB** / **5.0 MB** | 0.01s |

| Synthetic E-Graph Resolver | `horizon_resolve --collapse-dups` | Synthetic `200`-seg `ACGT` repeat, `20` identical walks (`--divergence 0.02`) | `280` windows, `840` dups collapsed, `308,760.9` analytical `2*len` bits | **24.0 MB** | 4.48s |
